captioned_images.current: 世纪90年代因土地批租而被拆迁的中世纪城堡式的双塔建筑。
1948年航空影像图，看见外侧一栋双塔的楼，位置现是绿地走道。内侧现在的洋楼还在，但被高楼贴身包围。再往东是瑞士国总领事馆，原址建了报业大楼。

historic_human_attribution.claimed_building_year: 1900, as described by this local-history author; no original building permit has been found.
historic_human_attribution.claimed_purchase: Reported from the British bank manager 托益 by 祥茂洋行买办陈炳谦. The source gives no transaction date.
historic_human_attribution.photograph_date: The image predates demolition. The upload/blog date does not date the exposure.
historic_human_attribution.aerial_date: 1948 as captioned in the source; the original survey collection and scale are not identified.

person_only.scope: 2020 family documentary sources on the person, business role and public hospital; the article is not used to identify or date the photographed building.

view.tower_shape: faceted, splayed roofs and modest crest rails
view.visibility: Central projection partly hidden by planting; no steps, door treatment or interior are asserted. Rear and complete street-block depth remain unknown.
view.color: Early image monochrome. Red brick is stated in the local history text, tones and trim are an interpretation.
view.scale: Image ratios only. Adopted model width 38.55 m, tower height 20.15 m and shallow section depth are approximate.

active_site.mode: history/address only, no current model rejection, no replacement geometry or collision
